---
title: "About the Project"
---

## Background

The College Baseball Explorer was created to bring modern sabermetric analysis to college baseball. While advanced metrics such as wOBA, wRC+, and FIP have become standard tools for evaluating Major League Baseball, comparable analytical resources for college baseball remain limited.

This project applies similar approaches to collegiate baseball, allowing player and team performance to be evaluated in greater context through interactive tools and reproducible statistical methods.

## Data Source

The College Baseball Explorer uses publicly available college baseball data enhanced with advanced sabermetric calculations dating back to 2011.

Advanced sabermetrics metrics include:

- wOBA
- wRC+
- ISO
- K-BB%
- FIP

The package standardizes raw statistics, calculates league context, and creates a consistent framework for comparing players and teams across seasons.


## Technology

The College Baseball Explorer was built using:

- **R** for data processing and statistical calculations
- **tidyverse** for data manipulation
- **Shiny** for the interactive web application
- **reactable** for dynamic player and team tables
- **ggplot2** for data visualization
- **Quarto** for this documentation website


## Development

This project was built as a way to explore the application of data analytics and statistical modeling within college baseball.

The goal is to make advanced baseball analysis more accessible while providing a reproducible framework for evaluating player and team performance.
